selector.name: INTERACTION_TARGET_CURRENT
selector.use: byte selector and four-byte table index

semantics: The helper implements a computed interaction-state transfer. It clears D4, loads the current selector byte, scales it by four, pushes the A0-relative destination longword onto the stack, and returns through the pushed destination. A zero selector additionally arms PLAYER_TERMINAL_TRANSITION.
conclusion: The former 0x001B0316-0x001B0333 UNKNOWN range is an indirect interaction target-state dispatcher sharing the terminal RTS at 0x001B0334.
